key.name: tile-columns
key.summary: Number of group columns on the tile board
key.description: Target number of side-by-side 6-unit group columns on the Windows 10 style tile board (1..4), automatically clamped to screen width.

key.name: menu-width
key.description: Stored free pixel width of the Sadeem Menu popup container (440..1800px).

key.name: menu-height
key.description: Free pixel height of the Sadeem Menu popup container (380..1020px).

key.name: icon-size-level
key.description: Unified 2D board cell preset index (0..4 mapped to cell presets 64x70, 70x76, 78x84, 88x94, 98x104px).

key.name: menu-opacity
key.description: Background opacity percentage for the Sadeem Menu surface (10..100).

key.name: show-all-apps-sidebar
key.description: Display the collapsible alphabetical All Apps sidebar with jump grid alongside the tile board.

key.name: show-most-used
key.description: Display Most Used apps inside the compact bottom strip.

key.name: most-used-count
key.description: Maximum number of Most Used apps shown in the bottom strip (1..4).

key.name: show-recently-installed
key.description: Display Recently Installed user and Flatpak apps inside the compact bottom strip.

key.name: recently-installed-count
key.description: Maximum number of Recently Installed apps shown in the bottom strip (1..4).

key.name: bottom-section-count
key.summary: Items per bottom strip section (legacy fallback)
key.description: Legacy fallback count of applications per section in the compact bottom strip (1..4).

key.name: auto-categorize
key.description: Automatically populate the built-in smart groups (Sadeem, Office, Games, Social).

key.name: disabled-smart-groups
key.description: List of built-in smart group IDs (sadeem, office, games, social) hidden individually by the user.

key.name: show-power-buttons
key.summary: Show power buttons in menu footer
key.description: Whether Lock, Restart, and Power Off buttons are shown in the footer.

key.name: bind-super-key
key.summary: Bind Super key to open Sadeem Menu
key.description: When enabled, pressing Super opens Sadeem Menu instead of GNOME Overview.

key.name: layout-config
key.description: JSON configuration storing unified groups, app tiles, tile folders, sizes, ordering, excluded_apps, and removed_groups.
